question: Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-3) × 9
solution:
**Given:**

Evaluate: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-3) × 9

**Formula used:**

Follow BODMAS rule: Brackets, Orders (exponents), Division and Multiplication (from left to right), Addition and Subtraction (from left to right).

**Calculation:**

Expression: (-9) - (-60) ÷ (-15) + (-3) × 9

⇒ (-9) - [(-60) ÷ (-15)] + [(-3) × 9]

⇒ (-9) - [4] + [-27]

⇒ (-9) - 4 - 27

⇒ -9 - 4 = -13

⇒ -13 - 27 = -40

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
